form_title: 2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Handwritten. The filer writes cents as a raised/superscript pair over the dollar figure (e.g. '16,060' with a superscript '00'); transcribed here in decimal form. The third digit of the expenditure figure (15,994.71) is written over itself and is legible only at medium confidence in both Column A and Column B; the digits after the comma are the ambiguous part, not the cents. Neither amendment box (Yes/No) is marked, so is_amendment is left empty rather than assumed 'No'. Cover carries a clerk received stamp (JUN 17 PM 12:49) and a handwritten '1 of 5'.
